Action: Explaining external call execution transfer to malicious fallback/receive functions before state balance updates; demonstrating the Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern (updating storage before transferring ETH) and OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard mutexes. Result: Elimination of reentrancy vectors and verified formal security.

title: Smart Contract Security & Decentralized Protocols: Reentrancy Attacks & Checks-Effects-Interactions
